card.name: Digits inside years and numbers
card.fires_on: Mainly a single digit right after a leading 1 in a year such as 1893 or 1990s, or in a numbered reference like Table 12. Also fires on "every" before a patient count.

modes.description: The word every in a rate statement, before a number of patients.
